name: Dust Bunny
flavour: You missed a spot. It noticed.
art_prompt: a tiny round fluffy ball of very dark charcoal-grey dust with a fuzzy outline, two long floppy rabbit ears on top, two big angry round white eyes with small black pupils under slanted brows, a small mouth with two tiny white teeth showing, no arms, no legs, no feet, a goofy mean cartoon dust ball, facing the viewer
motion: bouncing up and down in place, the whole ball as one piece, its face completely still
anim_negative: arms, legs, hands, feet, extra ears, extra eyes, two balls, the mouth moving, blinking
back_hint: seen directly from behind: the same round fuzzy charcoal-grey dust ball with its two long floppy ears on top, no eyes, no teeth, no face at all

DB-A.note: charcoal, floppy ears folded over at the tips, pink inside; it hops (the painting squashes and stretches, the ears lag, its face never moves); goes up in a puff, its eyes hanging in the cloud, a heap left (stills a2d: picked a2 with its greys darkened by tools/dl/p126/BESTIARY/darken.py, the game's fog lifts blacks)

DB-B.note: long thin ears drooping out to the sides; the same hop

DB-C.note: Pass 127 recolour of DB-A: sandy tan, so it reads pale on the Dust Bowl's brown haze (hue 36, saturation 0.36, value lifted onto 0.5..0.98); the black outline, the white eyes and teeth and the pink ears as they are (tools/recolour_strip.py --mode lift --max-val)

DB-D.note: Pass 127 recolour of DB-A: rust red, the warm dark one against the haze (hue 14, saturation 0.72, value lifted onto 0.38..0.85); the black outline, the white eyes and teeth and the pink ears as they are (tools/recolour_strip.py --mode lift --max-val)

doc: The Dust Bowl's swarm filler: a charcoal ball of dust with long ears and a mean little face, tens at a time, a third of a slot against the cap. One hit and it is a puff on the ground.
